text:
QUOTE: "the library runs no threads of its own" and "`library/threading.c` is wrapped in `#if defined(MBEDTLS_THREADING_C)`, so the global mutexes and the pthread wrapper are not built" (plus the table of mutexes that apply once `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` and a backend are enabled).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the library creates no threads of its own. It also says `threading.c` supplies the mutex and pthread wrapper abstraction, used by application threads when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is enabled. The "contains no mutexes" wording applies only to the default configuration.
